summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026, reporting the results of its Annual Meeting of Stockholders and Organizational Meeting held on June 9, 2026. The filing includes a disclosure letter submitted to the Philippine Stock Exchange and Securities and Exchange Commission detailing actions approved at those meetings. No specific voting results, director elections, or material corporate actions are provided in the excerpt. As a routine meeting notice with no special-situation event, this filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformation. There are no deal terms to report.
